canonical.title: Weekend at schanz., Piesport: where to sleep, what to do, when to go

sources.title: schanz. restaurant.
sources.claim: schanz. is a three-star Michelin restaurant in Piesport with attached hotel; Bahnhofstraße 8a, +49 6507 92520.

sources.title: schanz. hotel — about
sources.claim: schanz. hotel has 12 designer rooms by tibo architects, organised around five gourmet-product concepts, directly above the restaurant.

sources.title: schanz. hotel — pricing
sources.claim: schanz. hotel doubles €186–198 incl. breakfast (single-use €157–166); triple with balcony €259–268.

sources.title: Schanz Hotel — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Schanz Hotel rated 4.2/5 across 55 reviews, #1 of 3 small hotels in Piesport, rooms from ~€175/night; breakfast until 12:00 on checkout days.

sources.title: schanz. restaurant. — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Michelin Guide listing for schanz. at Bahnhofstraße 8a, 54498 Piesport.

sources.title: Restaurant Schanz — VisitMosel
sources.claim: Three Michelin stars; Thomas Schanz; modern French cuisine; Wed–Sat lunch and dinner; 3–4 h tasting menu.

sources.title: CiE 2026 — Trier University
sources.claim: Computability in Europe 2026 (CiE 2026) runs 27–31 July 2026 at Uni Trier Campus I; co-chairs Henning Fernau and Vasco Brattka; €200 registration before July 1.

sources.title: MCU 2026 — Trier University
sources.claim: Machines, Computations and Universality (MCU 2026) runs 27–29 July 2026 in Trier, co-located with CiE 2026.

sources.title: CCA 2026
sources.claim: 23rd International Conference on Computability and Complexity in Analysis runs 29–31 July 2026 in Trier as a CiE 2026 satellite.

sources.title: GSW 2026 — Trier University
sources.claim: Grammar Systems Workshop 2026 co-located in Trier with CiE 2026, MCU 2026 and CCA 2026.

sources.title: Taxi Reitz
sources.claim: Taxi Reitz (Bernkastel-Kues, 06531-6455) — Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00 office; off-hours bookings by phone.

sources.title: Mosel taxi list — Kesten
sources.claim: Fahrdienst Später (Piesport, 06507 802313) and Taxi Keusch (Neumagen-Dhron, 06507 2493) — pre-booking required.

sources.title: Wein- und Tafelhaus — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Michelin Guide listing for Wein- und Tafelhaus in Trittenheim.

sources.title: Wein- und Tafelhaus — VisitMosel
sources.claim: Boutique hotel in Trittenheim with seven individually designed rooms by a local carpenter; Michelin-starred chef Alexander Oos.

sources.title: Piesport → Bernkastel-Kues — rome2rio
sources.claim: Piesport to Bernkastel-Kues is 16.9 km by road, ~14 min by car, taxi estimated €40–55.

sources.title: Veldenz Castle — Bernkastel-Kues tourism
sources.claim: Burg Veldenz, 12th-c. hill castle above Mülheim; guided tours Wednesdays at 15:00 only.

sources.title: St-Nikolaus-Hospital (Cusanusstift) — VisitMosel
sources.claim: Cusanus Foundation in Bernkastel-Kues; medieval library tours Tuesdays 10:30 and Fridays 15:00.

sources.title: Stella Noviomagi Roman wine-ship
sources.claim: Neumagen-Dhron's Stella Noviomagi replica Roman wine-ship cruise — Saturday 16:00 sailing from the village dock.

sources.title: Meetup — Trier
sources.claim: No active tech/software/dev meetup groups in Trier as of May 2026 — largest local groups are language and gaming.

sources.title: IRDT Conference 2026
sources.claim: 'Politicians as Targets: Harmful Online Speech', 10–11 September 2026 at Uni Trier Campus II.

sources.title: Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Restored late-19th-c. castle hotel on the Mosel riverbank in Lieser, ~14 km from Piesport; Puricelli fine-dining restaurant in-house.

sources.title: Schloss Lieser — Marriott Autograph
sources.claim: Schloss Lieser is part of Marriott's Autograph Collection.

sources.title: Weinromantikhotel Richtershof
sources.claim: Weinromantikhotel Richtershof in Mülheim occupies a 300-year-old winery with a 16th-c. cellar; Baroque, Wilhelminian and Art Nouveau elements; vineyard-named rooms.

sources.title: Hotel-Restaurant Doctor Weinstube
sources.claim: Hotel-Restaurant Doctor Weinstube — 1668 tithe house in Bernkastel-Kues's old town, modernised 2013.

sources.title: Moselhaus Trittenheim — Clüsserath-Wittmann
sources.claim: Vintner-owned 2023 build with three apartments in Trittenheim, €140–210/night.

sources.title: Piesport — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Piesport-proper sits on the left (Eifel) bank of the Mosel; the right-bank district Niederemmel holds Bahnhofstraße and is joined to Piesport-proper by a single bridge.

sources.title: Moselsteig Stage 8 — Leiwen → Neumagen-Dhron
sources.claim: Moselsteig Stage 8 (14.09 km) — vineyards and rock-cliffs ending in Germany's oldest wine town at the Stella Noviomagi dock.

sources.title: Römersteig premium trail
sources.claim: Römersteig premium trail — 22.26 km from Hinkelstein (near Trittenheim) to Minheim, +435 m, ~6 h 20 min, with slate caves, Roman sites and a reconstructed wine press at Piesport.

sources.title: Zummethöhe panorama viewpoint
sources.claim: Zummethöhe between Leiwen and Trittenheim — voted 'Best of the Vineyard Views – Moselle' in 2016; junction of the Kronenberg and Sonnenberg circular trails (15 km loop together).

sources.title: Weingut Reinhold Haart
sources.claim: Weingut Reinhold Haart, Ausoniusufer 18 Piesport — 9 ha of Mosel steep slope incl. Goldtröpfchen; tastings by appointment.

sources.title: Burg Landshut — Bernkastel-Kues tourism
sources.claim: Burg Landshut — hilltop castle above Bernkastel-Kues with panoramic Mosel views.

sources.title: Piesport — Bernkastel-Kues tourism
sources.claim: Piesport's lodging tier is dominated by winery guesthouses and the riverside Hotel-Restaurant Moselblick.

sources.title: Piesporter Moselbogen — circular hike
sources.claim: Piesporter Moselbogen 'Leuchtpunkt' circular hike: ~7.98 km, ~2 h 15, easy, +105 m / -205 m through the Goldtröpfchen vineyard, starting at the Bürgerhaus Piesport.

sources.title: Weingut Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Weingut Schloss Lieser (Thomas Haag) — VDP top Mosel estate, Vinothek/shop hours Mon-Tue/Thu-Fri 10:00-17:00 and Sat 11:00-15:00.
